ezt írd at ugy (.replit a fajl) hogy run gombra nyomva a main.sc-t futtassa

run = "cowsay Configure me!"
entrypoint = "README.md"

[nix]
channel = "stable-24_11"
packages = ["cowsay", "llvm_18", "clang_18", "premake4", "wget", "curl", "gnumake", "libffi", "llvm_14", "clang_14", "llvm_12", "clang_12"]

[agent]
expertMode = true

[workflows]
runButton = "Project"

[[workflows.workflow]]
name = "Project"
mode = "parallel"
author = "agent"

[[workflows.workflow.tasks]]
task = "workflow.run"
args = "Scopes Runtime"

[[workflows.workflow]]
name = "Scopes Runtime"
author = "agent"

[[workflows.workflow.tasks]]
task = "shell.exec"
args = "bash install-scopes.sh && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=\"$HOME/scopes-install/bin:$HOME/scopes-install/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH\" && $HOME/scopes-install/bin/scopes main.sc"

[workflows.workflow.metadata]
outputType = "console"
